title: 18-Inch Towel Bar, Solid Brass Wall Mount | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels neatly displayed and easy to grab with a wall-mounted towel bar that brings traditional style to everyday bathroom organization in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Designed as part of the Carolina Collection, it coordinates effortlessly with matching Carolina accessories for a classic, timeless look.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Coordinates with other Carolina pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
  • Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Coordinated bathroom design: Pairs with other Carolina Collection pieces for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.
  • Built from solid brass: Brass construction for enduring use.

Specs & Installation
Length: 18 Inch
Overall width: 20
Depth (projection): 2
Height: 3.5
Weight: 2.4 lbs
Mounting: Wall mounted; concealed screw mounting; mounting hardware included
Multiple designer finish options available
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
